DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri)

The presence of mild papilledema combined with your history of hypertension, daily worsening headaches, and visual disturbances strongly suggests increased intracranial pressure. While hypertension can contribute, the specific eye findings point to a primary pressure issue rather than a stroke or tumor.
